mapper.sql: coupon_id, coupon_code, coupon_name, discount_type, discount_value, min_order_amount, max_discount_amount, issue_type, valid_from, valid_to, usage_limit, issued_count, status, created_at, updated_at

where.if: AND ( coupon_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR coupon_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT FROM COUPON
ORDER BY created_at DESC, coupon_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUPON) AS totalCoupons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUPON WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND valid_to >= NOW()) AS activeCoupons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUPON WHERE status <> 'STOPPED' AND (status = 'EXPIRED' OR valid_to < NOW())) AS expiredCoupons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUPON WHERE status = 'STOPPED') AS stoppedCoupons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER_COUPON) AS issuedMemberCoupons
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN mc.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.valid_to < NOW() THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE mc.status END

where.if: AND ( m.email LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.coupon_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.coupon_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT mc.member_coupon_id, mc.coupon_id, c.coupon_name, c.coupon_code, mc.member_id, m.email AS member_email, m.name AS member_name, mc.order_id, mc.issued_at, mc.used_at, AS status FROM MEMBER_COUPON mc JOIN COUPON c ON c.coupon_id = mc.coupon_id JOIN MEMBER m ON m.member_id = mc.member_id
ORDER BY mc.issued_at DESC, mc.member_coupon_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER_COUPON mc JOIN COUPON c ON c.coupon_id = mc.coupon_id JOIN MEMBER m ON m.member_id = mc.member_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER m WHERE m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MEMBER_COUPON mc WHERE mc.coupon_id = #{couponId} AND mc.member_id = m.member_id )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_COUPON (coupon_id, member_id) SELECT #{couponId}, m.member_id FROM MEMBER m WHERE m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MEMBER_COUPON mc WHERE mc.coupon_id = #{couponId} AND mc.member_id = m.member_id )
